goal: Compare parallel SD inference characteristics using matched SGLang Engine paths on RTX 5090, retain positive/negative and correctness evidence.
baseline: same SGLang commit, backend, BF16 target and target KV token capacity; AR has no unused draft model
primary_metrics: per-request decode throughput and prefill/queue latency
effective committed decode tokens per verify, excluding prefill seed
physical GPU memory and engine weight/KV/graph accounting
correctness: greedy output_ids vs same-engine AR; record first mismatch
separate theoretical rejection-sampling exactness from BF16 shape rounding
no answer-quality claim without task scoring

features.decode_CUDA_graph: full; actual replay must be verified
features.prefill_CUDA_graph: disabled for the initial decode-focused cohort, equal for all methods
features.raw_input_ids: same public prompt files for every batch size
features.Rust_extensions: not built; independent of GPU SD kernels

first_matrix.EOS: ignored for fixed-output resource-scaling cohort; separate EOS-enabled validation

followups: equal verify-width ablations vs each checkpoint default
BS2/8 if needed to locate crossover
DSpark compact verify with measured local SPS table; static vs scheduled separately
Qwen3.5-4B hybrid state/feature and commit profile
representative nsys BS1/16 traces only after warmup and graph checks
execution_policy: serialize GPU cells; reject active foreign compute; terminate only own group and retain yielded state if foreign compute appears; never overwrite failed attempts or restart on a polling timeout
interpretation_limits: native JetSpec is a different engine cohort
small prompt count is exploratory, not a publication leaderboard
busy/utilization alone does not prove compute bound
DFlash2 conversion needs functional/runtime validation; config/header checks are insufficient
